topics.title: Source Code & Software Repositories
topics.description: Corpora of source code and repository activity used to train code models and study how software is built.

topics.title: Software Defects & Testing
topics.description: Reproducible bugs, regressions and failing builds used for automated program repair, fault localisation and test-generation research.

topics.title: Security & Vulnerabilities
topics.description: Authoritative feeds of publicly disclosed software vulnerabilities and their severity metadata.

topics.title: Network Traffic & Intrusion Detection
topics.description: Labelled packet captures and flow records used to build and benchmark intrusion detection systems.

topics.title: Logs & Observability
topics.description: Production system logs and workload traces for log parsing, anomaly detection and performance benchmarking.

topics.title: Databases & Query Benchmarking
topics.description: Standard schemas, data generators and query workloads for comparing analytical and transactional database engines.

topics.title: Web Crawl & Internet-Scale Text
topics.description: Petabyte-scale crawls of the public web and the cleaned text corpora derived from them.

topics.title: Natural Language Processing
topics.description: Annotated text corpora for classification, question answering and language-understanding benchmarks.

topics.title: Computer Vision
topics.description: Labelled image collections for classification, detection and segmentation.

topics.title: Speech & Audio
topics.description: Transcribed speech corpora for automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech.

topics.title: Recommender Systems
topics.description: User-item interaction logs and reviews for collaborative filtering and ranking research.

topics.title: Search & Information Retrieval
topics.description: Query-document relevance judgements for training and evaluating retrieval and reranking systems.

topics.title: Tabular Machine Learning
topics.description: Curated repositories of small-to-medium tabular datasets used as standard classification and regression benchmarks.

topics.title: Time Series & Forecasting
topics.description: Large collections of time series with held-out horizons for reproducible forecasting evaluation.

topics.title: Fraud & Anomaly Detection
topics.description: Heavily imbalanced transaction datasets for fraud scoring and rare-event detection.

topics.title: Graphs & Networks
topics.description: Social, citation and web graphs for network analysis and graph neural network benchmarks.

topics.title: Geospatial & Mapping
topics.description: Open map data and cartographic base layers for geocoding, routing and visualisation.

topics.title: Finance & Economics
topics.description: Official macroeconomic and development indicators published by central banks and international bodies.

topics.title: E-commerce & Retail
topics.description: Transaction and basket data for demand forecasting, market basket analysis and customer segmentation.

topics.title: Transportation & Mobility
topics.description: Trip records and transit schedules for routing, demand modelling and urban analytics.

datasets.name: CodeSearchNet Corpus
datasets.description: Two million functions from open-source projects in six languages, each paired with its natural-language docstring, for code search and code-summarisation models.
datasets.license: MIT (tooling); individual functions retain their upstream repository licenses
datasets.cite: Husain et al. (2019), CodeSearchNet Challenge: Evaluating the State of Semantic Code Search. arXiv:1909.09436

datasets.name: GH Archive
datasets.description: Every public GitHub event since 2011, archived hourly and queryable in BigQuery, covering pushes, pull requests, issues and stars.
datasets.license: MIT (project); event data derived from the GitHub public timeline
datasets.cite: GH Archive, https://www.gharchive.org/

datasets.name: Defects4J
datasets.description: A reproducible collection of real Java bugs, each with a buggy and fixed revision plus the tests that expose the failure, and a harness that checks out and builds any of them on demand.
datasets.license: MIT
datasets.cite: Just, Jalali & Ernst (2014), Defects4J: A Database of Existing Faults to Enable Controlled Testing Studies for Java Programs. ISSTA 2014

datasets.name: BugSwarm
datasets.description: Fail-pass pairs of real continuous-integration builds packaged as Docker images, so a historical build failure and its fix can be reproduced exactly years later.
datasets.license: MIT (client tooling); artifacts retain upstream project licenses
datasets.cite: Tomassi et al. (2019), BugSwarm: Mining and Continuously Growing a Dataset of Reproducible Failures and Fixes. ICSE 2019

datasets.name: NVD Vulnerability Data Feeds
datasets.description: The US National Vulnerability Database's enriched view of every CVE, adding CVSS severity scores, CWE weakness classes and CPE product identifiers.
datasets.license: US Government public domain
datasets.cite: National Vulnerability Database, NIST

datasets.name: CVE List V5
datasets.description: The authoritative CVE Program record set in JSON 5.0 format, published directly to Git so every vulnerability disclosure has a full commit history.
datasets.license: CVE Program Terms of Use
datasets.cite: CVE Program, https://www.cve.org/

datasets.name: CIC-IDS2017
datasets.description: Five days of realistic background traffic interleaved with labelled brute-force, DoS, web-attack, infiltration and botnet scenarios, published as both raw PCAPs and extracted flow features.
datasets.provider: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity, University of New Brunswick
datasets.license: Free for research use with citation
datasets.cite: Sharafaldin, Lashkari & Ghorbani (2018), Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization. ICISSP 2018

datasets.name: UNSW-NB15
datasets.description: Synthetic-but-realistic network traffic covering nine attack families, with 49 engineered flow features and a fixed train/test split that has become a standard IDS benchmark.
datasets.license: Free for academic research with citation
datasets.cite: Moustafa & Slay (2015), UNSW-NB15: A Comprehensive Data Set for Network Intrusion Detection Systems. MilCIS 2015

datasets.name: Loghub
datasets.description: System logs from distributed systems, supercomputers, operating systems, mobile devices and servers, with hand-labelled templates for a subset, aimed at log parsing and anomaly detection.
datasets.license: Freely available for research; individual collections retain source terms
datasets.cite: He et al. (2020), Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets towards Automated Log Analytics. arXiv:2008.06448

datasets.name: Elasticsearch Rally Tracks
datasets.description: The standard benchmarking workloads for Elasticsearch, bundling real document corpora such as HTTP server logs, geonames and NYC taxi rides with the query mixes run against them.
datasets.records: Varies by track (millions to billions of documents)
datasets.license: No single license; chosen per track, typically matching the terms of the source data
datasets.cite: Elastic Rally, https://github.com/elastic/rally-tracks

datasets.name: TPC-H
datasets.description: The decision-support benchmark that defines a fixed eight-table schema, a scalable data generator and 22 analytical queries, used to compare query engines at scale factors from 1 GB to 100 TB.
datasets.license: TPC End User License Agreement (free download)
datasets.cite: Transaction Processing Performance Council, TPC Benchmark H

datasets.name: ClickBench
datasets.description: A single wide table of anonymised web analytics hits plus 43 typical aggregation queries, designed to compare analytical databases on realistic clickstream workloads.
datasets.license: Apache-2.0
datasets.cite: ClickBench, https://benchmark.clickhouse.com/

datasets.name: Common Crawl
datasets.description: A monthly crawl of the public web hosted free on S3, published as raw WARC responses plus extracted plain text and link graphs, and the upstream source for most open LLM pretraining corpora.
datasets.license: Common Crawl Terms of Use
datasets.cite: Common Crawl Foundation, https://commoncrawl.org/

datasets.name: C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)
datasets.description: A heavily filtered English subset of Common Crawl created for training T5, with deduplication, boilerplate removal and language detection already applied.
datasets.license: ODC-BY 1.0; underlying text subject to Common Crawl terms
datasets.cite: Raffel et al. (2020), Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer. JMLR 21(140)

datasets.name: Large Movie Review Dataset (IMDB)
datasets.description: Polar movie reviews split evenly into positive and negative classes with a balanced train/test partition, the default smoke test for text classification pipelines.
datasets.license: Research use; see dataset README
datasets.cite: Maas et al. (2011), Learning Word Vectors for Sentiment Analysis. ACL 2011

datasets.name: SQuAD 2.0
datasets.description: Crowd-written questions over Wikipedia paragraphs, combining answerable questions with adversarially written unanswerable ones so models must learn to abstain.
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0
datasets.cite: Rajpurkar, Jia & Liang (2018), Know What You Don't Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD. ACL 2018

datasets.name: COCO (Common Objects in Context)
datasets.description: Everyday scenes annotated with object instance masks, keypoints, panoptic segments and five captions per image, the reference benchmark for detection and segmentation.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (annotations); images subject to their original Flickr terms
datasets.cite: Lin et al. (2014), Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context. ECCV 2014

datasets.name: CIFAR-10 / CIFAR-100
datasets.description: Small 32x32 colour images across 10 or 100 balanced classes, small enough to iterate on in minutes and still the standard sanity check for new architectures.
datasets.license: Research use; attribution requested
datasets.cite: Krizhevsky (2009), Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images. Technical Report, University of Toronto

datasets.name: Mozilla Common Voice
datasets.description: Crowd-donated and crowd-validated read speech released into the public domain, covering more than a hundred languages including many with little other ASR data.
datasets.size: Varies by language (tens of GB for English)
datasets.cite: Ardila et al. (2020), Common Voice: A Massively-Multilingual Speech Corpus. LREC 2020

datasets.name: LibriSpeech
datasets.description: Read English audiobook speech from LibriVox, force-aligned to its Project Gutenberg source text and split into clean and noisy subsets that define the standard ASR difficulty tiers.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.cite: Panayotov et al. (2015), Librispeech: An ASR Corpus Based on Public Domain Audio Books. ICASSP 2015

datasets.name: MovieLens 25M
datasets.description: Star ratings and free-text tags collected from the MovieLens service over 24 years, the most widely used benchmark for collaborative filtering.
datasets.license: GroupLens usage license: research use only, no redistribution, no commercial use without permission
datasets.cite: Harper & Konstan (2015), The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4)

datasets.name: Amazon Reviews 2023
datasets.description: Product reviews spanning 1996 to 2023 with ratings, review text, images and rich item metadata, organised into 33 product categories for large-scale recommendation research.
datasets.license: Research use; cite the source papers
datasets.cite: Hou et al. (2024), Bridging Language and Items for Retrieval and Recommendation. arXiv:2403.03952

datasets.name: MS MARCO
datasets.description: Real anonymised Bing queries paired with human-judged passages and documents, the dataset that made neural ranking models practical to train at scale.
datasets.license: MS MARCO non-commercial research license
datasets.cite: Bajaj et al. (2016), MS MARCO: A Human Generated MAchine Reading COmprehension Dataset. arXiv:1611.09268

datasets.name: BEIR
datasets.description: A heterogeneous zero-shot retrieval benchmark that wraps 18 existing IR datasets behind one loader and evaluation protocol, so a retriever can be scored across domains without per-dataset plumbing.
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 (toolkit); each subset retains its own license
datasets.cite: Thakur et al. (2021), BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks

datasets.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
datasets.description: The longest-running public collection of machine learning datasets, hosting the small tabular classics such as Iris, Adult, Wine Quality and Covertype behind a consistent Python API.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for most datasets; check per dataset
datasets.cite: Kelly, Longjohn & Nottingham, The UCI Machine Learning Repository, https://archive.ics.uci.edu

datasets.name: OpenML
datasets.description: Datasets, tasks, flows and millions of recorded experiment runs behind one REST API, including the curated CC-18 and AutoML benchmark suites for reproducible model comparison.
datasets.license: Varies per dataset; mostly CC BY or public domain
datasets.cite: Vanschoren et al. (2013), OpenML: Networked Science in Machine Learning. SIGKDD Explorations 15(2)

datasets.name: M4 Competition Dataset
datasets.description: One hundred thousand real series at yearly through hourly frequencies drawn from demographics, finance, industry and macro sources, with held-out horizons and every competitor's submitted forecasts.
datasets.license: Open for research and benchmarking; see repository
datasets.cite: Makridakis, Spiliotis & Assimakopoulos (2020), The M4 Competition: 100,000 Time Series and 61 Forecasting Methods. International Journal of Forecasting 36(1)

datasets.name: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive
datasets.description: Thirty forecasting datasets normalised into a single .tsf format with baseline results for statistical and deep models, covering tourism, traffic, electricity, weather and web traffic.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.cite: Godahewa et al. (2021), Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks

datasets.name: Credit Card Fraud Detection
datasets.description: Two days of European cardholder transactions with PCA-anonymised features and a 0.172% positive rate, the canonical teaching example for extreme class imbalance.
datasets.license: Database Contents License (DbCL) v1.0
datasets.cite: Dal Pozzolo et al. (2015), Calibrating Probability with Undersampling for Unbalanced Classification. IEEE SSCI 2015

datasets.name: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection
datasets.description: Real e-commerce transactions from Vesta with 400+ engineered features spanning device, card, address and identity signals, plus a separately joined identity table.
datasets.provider: IEEE Computational Intelligence Society / Vesta Corporation
datasets.license: Competition rules; non-commercial research use
datasets.cite: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection, Kaggle (2019)

datasets.name: SNAP Large Network Dataset Collection
datasets.description: Social, citation, collaboration, web, road and communication networks in a uniform edge-list format, ranging from thousands to billions of edges.
datasets.size: KB to hundreds of GB per network
datasets.license: BSD-3-Clause (library); datasets vary, cite the source paper
datasets.cite: Leskovec & Krevl (2014), SNAP Datasets: Stanford Large Network Dataset Collection

datasets.name: Open Graph Benchmark
datasets.description: Large realistic graph benchmarks for node, link and graph property prediction, shipping with standardised non-random splits and an automated evaluator to stop leaderboard drift.
datasets.license: MIT (package); datasets carry individual licenses such as ODC-BY and CC BY
datasets.cite: Hu et al. (2020), Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. NeurIPS 2020

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Planet
datasets.description: The complete crowd-mapped world as a single weekly export of nodes, ways and relations, plus daily and minutely diffs for keeping a local mirror current.
datasets.license: ODbL 1.0 (share-alike; attribution required)
datasets.cite: OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

datasets.name: Natural Earth
datasets.description: Public-domain vector and raster base maps at three cartographic scales, with boundaries, coastlines, rivers, cities and shaded relief built to line up cleanly across layers.
datasets.records: Vector and raster layers at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m
datasets.license: Public domain
datasets.cite: Made with Natural Earth, https://www.naturalearthdata.com/

datasets.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
datasets.description: Macroeconomic time series aggregated from more than a hundred official sources, covering rates, employment, prices and output, with a well-documented REST API and vintage-aware ALFRED archive.
datasets.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
datasets.license: FRED Terms of Use; many series carry upstream copyright restrictions
datasets.cite: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/

datasets.name: World Bank Open Data
datasets.description: Development indicators for every country from 1960 onward, covering GDP, population, health, education, energy and trade, all available in bulk and through a free API.
datasets.size: ~200 MB for the full WDI archive
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.cite: World Bank Open Data, https://data.worldbank.org/

datasets.name: Online Retail II
datasets.description: Every transaction of a UK online gift retailer over two years, with invoice, product, quantity, price, customer and country columns, widely used for RFM segmentation and basket analysis.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.cite: Chen, D. (2019), Online Retail II. UCI Machine Learning Repository

datasets.name: Instacart Market Basket Analysis
datasets.description: Anonymised grocery orders with per-order product sequences, reorder flags, aisle and department taxonomies, and day-of-week and hour-of-day signals for next-basket prediction.
datasets.license: Instacart Data Sharing Agreement; non-commercial use
datasets.cite: The Instacart Online Grocery Shopping Dataset 2017, accessed via Kaggle

datasets.name: NYC TLC Trip Record Data
datasets.description: Every yellow taxi, green taxi, for-hire and high-volume for-hire trip in New York City since 2009, with pickup and dropoff timestamps, zones, distances and fare breakdowns.
datasets.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
datasets.cite: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission, TLC Trip Record Data

datasets.name: Mobility Database
datasets.description: A catalogue of public transit feeds worldwide in GTFS and GTFS-Realtime, with a stable API and validation reports so schedule and vehicle-position data can be pulled without hunting agency websites.
datasets.license: Catalogue CC0; individual feeds carry their agency licenses
datasets.cite: MobilityData, Mobility Database, https://mobilitydatabase.org/
